name: Pixel Jitter
algorithm: Pixel Jitter — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method detects pixel-level temporal jitter for video deepfake detection:

1. **Sub-像素运动分析**: Per-pixel temporal variation is measured in regions that should be static (stationary background, stable facial features during stillness). Sub-pixel motion is extracted using phase-based methods to detect motion below one-pixel magnitude.

2. **Jitter频率分析**: The temporal frequency content of per-pixel variation is analyzed. Natural video shows specific jitter signatures: (a) sensor read noise (white noise, typically < 1 LSB), (b) quantization dither, (c) compression artifact variation. AI-generated video may show jitter with different spectral characteristics — frame-independent rendering produces temporally uncorrelated pixel variations.

3. **空间Jitter模式**: The spatial distribution of jitter intensity is mapped. Natural jitter is spatially uniform (same sensor for all pixels). AI-generated jitter may be spatially non-uniform — varying in intensity across the frame or showing different jitter characteristics in generated face regions vs. original background.

4. **人脸-BackgroundJitter比较**: Jitter characteristics of face pixels are compared with background pixels. In authentic video, both originate from the same sensor and show identical noise characteristics. Deepfake composites show different jitter signatures between the generated face and original background.

5. **Jitter-运动Decoupling**: The method separates true motion from jitter to avoid false positives. Genuine micro-motion (physiological tremor, breathing) is distinguished from generation artifacts based on spatial coherence and frequency characteristics. The forensic score quantifies the anomalous jitter component.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through 像素 jitter analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频

references.title: Zheng, Y. et al. (2021). Exploring Temporal Coherence for More General Video Face Forgery Detection. ICCV.
Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
